name: Shenzhou Zhe Jian Lu
source:
A person who "resurrected from the dead" has led to 20 years of grievances and entanglements.
A wish of "resurrection", revealing the historical truth of the 15th century.
Shenzhou and Schicksal, Taixuan and Tianqiong, Seven Disciples and Five Essences...
All the mysteries from 500 years ago are solved here.

A companion visual novel to Honkai Impact 3rd about Fu Hua, Otto Apocalypse and Li Sushang.
translation:
一个“死而复生”的人，引来了20年的恩怨纠葛。
一个“复活”的愿望，揭示了15世纪的历史真相。
神州与天命，太玄与天穹，七弟子五精……
500年前的所有谜团都在这里得到解答。

《崩坏3》的姊妹篇视觉小说，讲述符华、奥托启示录和李苏商的故事。
